note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect and until is derived by hand from the 16 printed wires (no erratum) and the page's rule that pushbutton 6 makes the rotary switch show the number held in the slide switches, not from a printed answer beyond step 3's dial 4. Topology: wiper D16 and D18 on minus; the six slide-switch arms are one node on D19; each LEFT contact nR goes to Dn; pushbutton 6 N.O. feeds + to D17. Pushbutton 6 down gives RUN (D17 +, D18 -); the wiper reaching the Dn of a LEFT switch shorts D19 to D18 (STOP), so the dial rests on the stored number; R1 (D17-D19) limits the rail current, so the breaker holds. Script choices, not printed: switch 2 then switch 6 as step 4's 'another number' (one LEFT switch at a time, so the rest pad does not depend on direction of travel), the 5 s held windows, the 2 s release windows, the 250 ms re-press check, and holding then releasing pushbutton 6 each time. Not asserted: direction of travel, motor speed, the dial start position (construction state), the case of two or more LEFT switches (the first LEFT pad met in the direction of travel wins, a direction-dependent outcome the page's one-number rule does not cover), and the dial with every switch RIGHT (it turns while pushbutton 6 is held and its rest after release depends on the coast fallback O-R5). Lamps and relays are unwired.
